input_format: protobuf text format, proto2 HttpProto with required string fields request and reply
configuration_profile: upstream embedded HTTP reverse proxy configuration

scopes.contract: Consumes one complete PROXY v1/v2 header and returns the first byte after it, or NULL on rejection; stores parsed metadata in c->proxy_protocol.
scopes.preconditions: Connection log and pool are valid; buf..last is one contiguous candidate header (not a streaming contract).
scopes.reachability: The embedded upstream listener has no proxy_protocol parameter, so this function requires a measured follow-up target if coverage remains zero.

expected_results: normal completion for accepted and rejected HTTP messages
state: The nginx cycle is initialized once; request connections and pools are created and finalized for every input.
known_limitations: Input is delivered by the upstream recv adapters, not a real TCP stack.
The embedded listener does not enable PROXY protocol, TLS, HTTP/2 or HTTP/3.
The upstream send/event/syscall wrappers intentionally model only the behavior needed by this target.
